name: @swao/module-terraform
description: SWAO Terraform generation module (Consultant tier): the `generate-tf` command (Terraform modules for the matched sovereign landing zone) plus its GenerateTfScreen (ADR-0048 modular architecture, Phase 5, #0578). TF generation is not yet implemented; the command is a tier-gated stub today. The runtime gate is `requireTier('consultant', { feature: 'generate-tf' })` (ADR-0049: tier-gating is runtime requireTier; the command stays visible). The host injects its SWAO version (branding is host-only) into the screen.
